title: Status API hooks
description: useStatus(), useWorkers(), useRecentJobs(), useRecentRuns() React Query hooks for the command center page.
definitionOfDone: All hooks use React Query with appropriate stale times

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/hooks/useStatus.ts: useStatus() React Query hook fetching GET /api/v1/status with 10s refetchInterval. Returns system status: worker counts, active jobs, success rate, pending approvals, avg eval latency, pipeline stats. useWorkersSummary() hook fetching GET /api/v1/workers for the command center (re-uses worker type from api/types.ts). useRecentJobs() fetching GET /api/v1/jobs?limit=10&sort=created_at:desc. useRecentRuns() fetching GET /api/v1/workflows/runs?limit=10&sort=created_at:desc. All hooks use apiClient from api/client.ts with proper auth headers.
Verify: run tsc --noEmit to ensure hooks compile correctly with api/types.ts types.
